subject: Spark has lost all  R pacakges

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Spark has lost all  R pacakges
parts:
Hello,
 I have been having some problems with my app on Spark. It seems that spark lost all of the R packages that were installed. I have re-installed some of the packages but I can't re-installl nlme as there is no R 2.15 version available. Does anyone know how I can get an old version of that package to be installed on spark?

Note - I am moving the app off of spark, but it needs some updating to so I would be nice to still have it on spark in the meantime.

JP

messages.author: 48725385c294169f
messages.subject: Re: Spark has lost all  R pacakges
parts:
This happened to me with MASS. What I did was make to delete the MASS folder in my personal R library and then load in MASS through the RStudio packages tab. It never got lost, the loaded packages just got reset or something. Alternatively, you can just use: library("nlme", lib.loc="/usr/lib/R/library")
and it should still work
